title: Calculation of the Warranty Coverage No-Show Fee
content:
**Clause.** For a missed technician visit booked on a Warranty Coverage claim, the missed visits counted are all the no-show visits recorded on the registration, the missed visit being billed included. The no-show fee of a chargeable missed visit is the warranty plan's no-show fee, charged once for that visit. A missed visit is chargeable only when the missed visits counted are more than the plan's free no-show count; a missed visit that is not chargeable carries no fee and nothing is booked.

**Amount.** The fee is the no-show fee multiplied by the repeat rate, the day rate and the crew rate of the visit, each of which is one. The product is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, an amount exactly halfway between two cents going to the higher cent. A chargeable missed visit whose fee works out to zero books nothing and owes no fee entry.

The warranty plan's no-show fee and its free no-show count are the figures of the plan's appointment schedule. The missed visit priced is the one recorded on the warranty claim the visit was booked for, and the fee is tied to that claim.

## Condition and result

| Missed visits counted on the registration | Compared with the plan's free no-show count | Result |
|---|---|---|
| more than the free count | chargeable | the fee is booked, once, for that visit |
| equal to or fewer than the free count | not chargeable | no fee; nothing is booked |

## Worked figures (hypothetical plan: no-show fee 80.00, free no-show count 1)

1. The registration records two no-show visits, the one being billed included. Two is more than one, so the visit is chargeable: 80.00 multiplied by one, one and one is 80.00, booked once.
2. The registration records one no-show visit, the one being billed. One is not more than one: no fee, and nothing is booked.
3. With a hypothetical free no-show count of 0, the very first no-show visit on the registration is chargeable.

## Rounding

The amount is rounded only once, after the multiplication, to the cent; a product of 80.005 becomes 80.01.
